BiblicalUsage: The breadth of the image is six cubits, and the house of God is finished in the sixth year of Darius.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe six cubits and six years are measured and finished, and the God who measures them is not measured.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
